Fun, energetic and packed with music, storytelling and plenty of opportunities for children to get involved, this is a charming 50 minute show that brings traditional West African and Caribbean folk tales to life in a way that feels accessible for a young audience.

cn.t: Critics praise this charming 50-minute adaptation for young audiences as energetic, interactive fun that introduces children to theatre memorably. The musical storytelling delights, creating the kind of magic that fosters lifelong theatre lovers.
